Recover ios_base callback registration with returned-pair ABI

Replace the 132-byte dump at 0x0083F1C0 with the vendored STLport
ios_base::register_callback implementation. Its grow helper returns
a non-POD pair, giving the caller the native hidden-result ABI.

Correct the existing 147-byte helper identity at 0x0083EF20 through
add_match and retire its superseded standalone TU. Preserve both
117-byte iword/pword siblings and their existing fallback data cells.

Native Windows diagnostic run 40124446904 reproduced all four
instruction bodies with the original compiler. The relocation-aware
check left only the callback call to the newly corrected helper
unresolved before normal admission. Identity evidence records the
retail comparison and donor d8dcd30e0cda47386f50b031c2bbcc8b9910cc02.

The primary callback adds 132 C++ exact bytes; the helper correction
and preserved siblings add no additional coverage.
